title: Graph Homomorphism Distortion: A structural (pseudo)-metric for attributed graphs
abstract: arXiv:2511.03068v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A large driver of the complexity of graph learning is the interplay between structure and features. When analyzing the expressivity of graph neural networks, however, existing approaches ignore features in favor of structure, making it nigh-impossible to assess to what extent two graphs with close features should be considered similar. We address this by developing a new (pseudo-)metric based on graph homomorphisms Inspired by concepts from metric geometry, our graph homomorphism distortion measures the minimal worst-case distortion that node features of one graph are subjected to when mapping one graph to another. We demonstrate the utility of our (pseudo-)metric by showing that i.) it can be efficiently approximated while retaining distinction capabilities, ii.) it provides a granular approach to graph distinction, and, iii.) it serves as a structural encoding, extending the concept of homomorphism-based descriptors to attributed g

translated_title: 图同态失真：一种面向属性图的结构化（伪）度量
translated_abstract: 图学习的复杂性很大程度上源于结构与特征之间的相互作用。然而，在分析图神经网络表达能力时，现有方法往往忽略特征而只关注结构，这使得几乎无法评估两个特征相近的图应在多大程度上被视为相似。为解决这一问题，我们基于图同态提出了一种新的（伪）度量。受度量几何概念的启发，我们的图同态失真度量的是将一个图映射到另一个图时，节点特征所承受的最小最坏情况失真。我们通过以下三点展示了该（伪）度量的实用性：i.) 它可以被高效近似，同时保持区分能力；ii.) 它提供了一种细粒度的图区分方法；iii.) 它可作为结构编码使用，将基于同态的描述符扩展至属性图。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于图同态的新型（伪）度量——图同态失真，通过衡量图间映射时节点特征的最小最坏失真来实现属性图的高效、细粒度区分，并可作为结构编码将基于同态的描述符扩展到属性图。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces graph homomorphism distortion, a novel (pseudo)-metric inspired by metric geometry that measures the minimal worst-case distortion of node features when mapping between graphs, enabling efficient, fine-grained distinction of attributed graphs and extending homomorphism-based descriptors as structural encodings.
